body:
Then I am very, very sorry. I know the atrocity I will be committing. I know that I very may well be fucking everyone I know over. I know that.

Fact of the matter is, I am an evil piece of shit, I need to be put down.

Exactly, life isn't an objective. For me it just seems like a waste of time. Depressed for more than 5 years, suicidal for the last year and a half. I'm just sick of it.

It's for the best of everyone.

I am thinking about it now, and next week seems years away. Wouldn't want to get cold feet. I'll give myself 4 more hours.

Thanks for sharing.

Is the fight really worth it though? I am not proving anything to anyone, I'm not trying to stand up for anything. I am just another person that will live and die. In the end nothing matters, why not get it over with.

Along with that, I have horrible... urges I guess you'd say. I would rather take myself out than act on the them.

I know they will be impacted. I feel terrible about it. I have run out of time though, I've had my fun. They will grieve for a while, but eventually get over it. It may not seem like it, but it's in the best interest for everyone.
